tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.panelDescription: Click below to create a ticket.
tickets.welcomeDescription: Hello, the support team will reply as soon as possible.
tickets.OPEN_TICKET_EXISTS: You already have an open ticket.
tickets.PERSISTENCE_ERROR: The ticket could not be saved. Please contact the server staff.
tickets.TICKET_GUILD_OR_MEMBER_MISSING: This ticket action requires a server member context.
tickets.TICKET_CHANNEL_CREATION_FAILED: The ticket channel could not be created.
tickets.TICKET_MEMBER_MISSING: The ticket creator is no longer available in this server.
tickets.TICKET_BOT_MISSING: The bot member is unavailable in this server.
tickets.TICKET_PERMISSION_INSUFFICIENT: The bot does not have sufficient permissions to configure this ticket.
tickets.TICKET_OVERWRITE_FAILED: The ticket permissions could not be configured.
tickets.TICKET_WELCOME_SEND_FAILED: The ticket welcome message could not be sent.
tickets.TICKET_NOT_FOUND: This channel is not an active CIVRAT ticket.

tickets.TICKET_UNAUTHORIZED: You are not allowed to close this ticket.
tickets.TICKET_GUILD_MISMATCH: This ticket does not belong to this server.
tickets.TICKET_CLOSE_FAILED: The ticket could not be closed.
tickets.TICKET_REOPEN_FAILED: The ticket could not be reopened.

tickets.TICKET_MEMBER_REMOVED: The member was removed from the ticket.
tickets.TICKET_MEMBER_ACCESS_FAILED: The ticket member access could not be updated.
tickets.TICKET_DISCORD_ERROR: A Discord error occurred while preparing the ticket.
tickets.TRANSPORT_ERROR: Ticket panel could not be sent.
tickets.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to manage tickets.
